item.title: Victor Garber Joins Cast of New Film Adaptation of Kay Thompson's ELOISE
item.description: Tony Award-nominated performer Victor Garber is among the newly confirmed cast for Eloise, the forthcoming live-action film adaptation of the beloved book series by Kay Thompson. According to Deadline, Sally Hawkins, David Haig, Max Casella, and Isaac Bae will round out the cast, which is led by Ryan Reynolds as an antagonist and newcomer Mae Schenk as the title character. item.title: THE JANICE JAM to Collaborate With MASQUERADE for Pink Night
item.description: The Janice Jam, Founded by Broadway performer Matt DeAngelis (Swept Away) in loving memory of his mother Janice, who passed away from metastatic breast cancer in 2022, is presenting a special collaboration with Masquerade for a one-night-only event: Masquerade: Pink Night. item.title: Review Roundup: Elevator Repair Service's ULYSSES at The Public
item.description: The Public Theater is presenting Elevator Repair Service’s Ulysses, presented in partnership with Under the Radar festival. item.title: Beth Malone, Krysta Rodriguez and Sam Gravitte to Star in STARSTRUCK at Bucks County Playhouse
item.description: Bucks County Playhouse has revealed the cast and creative team for the world premiere of “Starstruck,” a new musical comedy that kicks off the Playhouse’s 2026 mainstage season. Previews begin Feb. 19, with an official opening night Feb. 28. The production runs through March 21. item.title: Isaiah Johnson to Return as George Washington in HAMILTON on Broadway
item.description: Isaiah Johnson will return to Broadway for a limited engagement this early 2026, reprising his role as George Washington in Hamilton. Johnson previously played the role on the national tour. He will begin performances on Tuesday, January 27. A versatile actor across stage and screen, Johnson has appeared as a series regular on Netflix’s Florida Man and OWN’s David Makes Man, with recurring roles on OWN’s All Rise. item.title: KISS OF THE SPIDER WOMAN to Make Hulu Streaming Debut in February
item.description: Kiss of the Spider Woman, the 2025 adaptation of the Broadway musical, will be available to stream on Hulu beginning February 27, 2026, in the United States. This comes four months after its theatrical release last year. After holding its world premiere at the 2025 Sundance Film Festival, the movie had a short-lived theatrical run in October that grossed $1.6 million worldwide. item.title: Renée Elise Goldsberry Joins CBS Legal Drama CUPERTINO From Robert and Michelle King
item.description: Tony Award winner Renée Elise Goldsberry will reunite with Robert and Michelle King in Cupertino, a legal drama series from the writing and producing team, Deadline reports. Goldsberry previously worked with the Kings in recurring roles in The Good Wife and Evil.
